title: The Silent Hyperparameter: Quantifying the Impact of Inference Backends on LLM Reproducibility
abstract: arXiv:2605.19537v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Progress in LLMs is increasingly measured through standardized benchmarks, where state-of-the-art improvements are often separated by fractions of a percentage point. At the same time, the computational cost of evaluating modern LLMs has driven widespread adoption of specialized inference backends, software systems that execute trained models efficiently at inference time. While critical for scalability, system-level optimizations, such as custom CUDA kernels and reduced-precision arithmetic, can alter token probabilities and introduce non-determinism, possibly cascading into divergent generation. In this work, we first survey the inference landscape, identifying $200$ distinct engines, and analyze $35,000$ ML publications, finding that the specific inference stack is rarely reported despite this widespread diversity. translated_title: 沉默的超参数：量化推理后端对大语言模型可复现性的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.19537v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型的进展越来越多地通过标准化基准测试来衡量，其中最先进水平的提升往往仅相差百分之零点几。与此同时，评估现代大语言模型的高昂计算成本推动了专用推理后端的广泛采用——这类软件系统可在推理阶段高效地执行已训练的模型。尽管系统级优化（如自定义CUDA内核和低精度算术）对可扩展性至关重要，但它们可能改变token概率并引入非确定性，进而可能导致生成结果出现分歧。在这项工作中，我们首先调研了推理领域的现状，识别出200个不同的推理引擎，并分析了35,000篇机器学习出版物，发现尽管推理后端种类繁多，但具体的推理技术栈却很少被报告。随后，我们对推理后端如何影响大语言模型基准测试结果进行了系统的实证研究，在保持模型……
tldr: 该论文通过调研200个推理引擎和分析35,000篇ML论文，首次系统量化了推理后端这一常被忽视的“沉默超参数”对大语言模型基准测试结果与可复现性的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically quantifies the impact of inference backends—an overlooked "silent hyperparameter"—on LLM benchmark results and reproducibility, by surveying 200 inference engines and analyzing 35,000 ML publications that rarely report their inference stack.
